basis: User-approved series details and later explicit corrections. Latest explicit user changes and the accepted episode ledger take priority. No reference media is embedded or assumed uploaded.

fia.name: Fia
accessories: ornate vintage key with attached opal teardrop pendant

theo.name: Theo
theo.build: round and wider than Fia; preserve accepted relative size
theo.paw_coordinate_system: anatomical; right_forepaw is viewer-left only in an unmirrored frontal view

tail.shape: short thick natural feline tail, continuously attached

series_defaults.acting: feline locomotion and body language; expressive stylized animation without human gestures

audio.override: Honor the latest episode-specific audio instruction, including no music.

opal_effect.when: only when an approved story beat activates the key
opal_effect.avoid: unrequested golden energy trails or always-on neon fur

series_defaults.fantasy_combat: off unless the approved scene calls for it
series_defaults.image_count: minimum justified by the selected workflow, not a fixed six or eight
